newsitem.title: ISRAEL: KFC to open restaurant in Gaza.
newsitem.headline: KFC to open restaurant in Gaza.

text.p: Palestinian-ruled Gaza will soon get its first American fast food outlet.
A Kentucky Fried Chicken (KFC) restaurant will open next month near the beach in Gaza City, the franchise holder Haidar Abu Karsh said on Wednesday.
"Chicken is very popular and close to Middle Eastern food," the Gazan businessman told Reuters. The restaurant will serve chicken raised in Gaza but will import KFC's spices from Egypt.
He bought the franchise with two partners through an Egyptian company for $200,000 and has already sent employees to Egypt for training.
Israel handed over most of the Gaza Strip to Palestinian self-rule in 1994.
PepsiCo Inc said last month it would spin off its restaurant operations, including KFC, by distributing shares to existing shareholders.
